args.body: Take CATALOGUE-DOWNLOAD-FULFILLMENT from the completed checkout-fit verdict and the committed activation handoff if available. Reuse an equivalent tested archive if it exists. Otherwise, if the verdict supports standalone checkout subject to activation and licenses cover each included file, assemble the exact download and verify it from a clean extraction using the documented synthetic example. Read back the archive manifest, actual execution result and operator upload filename before closing with a valid lease and a lesson. A missing file-specific right blocks packaging that file. If it is essential, record the controlling evidence and reopening trigger. Keep archive readiness, activation, buyer delivery and verified settlement separate. No upload, external send, spending or public deployment.
